_comment: Synthetic fixture (not a real pill box photo) generated for server/tests_e2e/test_golden_path.py. The E2E test stubs agent.vision.ocr to return exactly these fields rather than diffing against a real OCR call, so this file documents the fixture's ground truth rather than driving an automated comparison — a real golden-eval harness (spec §8.3) is future work, tracked as a gap in the project's e2e/testing notes.
